summary: Sandbach United kicked off their 2026/27 season with a solid 1-0 home victory over Stafford Town, with a first-half goal from Tatters proving the difference in a battling performance. The Bach kept a clean sheet despite some nervous moments late on, including a penalty appeal for Stafford in the 72nd minute, to secure a welcome three points on opening day. Several substitutions in the second half helped maintain their dominance as they looked to build on this positive start in the NWCFL Premier Division.
